external.description:
Alt: My reaction to the idea that GIFs that show a faux progress bar are being used as a social engineering attack.

Images aren't generally payloads, but sometimes they contain them.  And sometimes they are used to trick people into believing something so they click and _then_ get a payload.  Other times they're used to look so normal that you don't notice that this was not the website you were looking for, and accidentally give creds.

FWIW I think it's wonderful we live in a world where most hacks can only happen after someone does something stupid.

Social Engineering Attacks have been with us since the dawn of time and will be with us until the dusk.
external.title: J. Jonah Jameson Laughing Hysterically
